_note: The White Tusk dental clinic again (same prescriber as 17.jpg), dated 13/10/2022. Clean fully-visible page, so raw_text is included for CER/WER coverage. DELIBERATE EXCLUSION: the final line, 'Oral B Pro 2 2000N electric brush', is a TOOTHBRUSH - a branded consumer product with a model number that reads exactly like a drug-plus-strength ('Pro 2 2000N'). It is not a medicine and is not listed, making this a false-positive probe embedded inside a positive page. Colgate Plax mouthwash IS listed: it is a prescribed medicated rinse, the same call made for Hexigel in 17.jpg. The second drug is written such that 'Zerodol PT' (a very common Indian dental analgesic) and a literal reading of 'Zeeodol' are both defensible; recorded as Zerodol PT but flagged certain:false rather than silently corrected.
